definitions.gloss: daily, day-by-day, on a daily basis
definitions.explanation: Happening or done every day, or organized by individual days. Used especially in business and data contexts.

examples.japanese: {日次|にちじ}⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
{日次|にちじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日次|にちじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦バックアップ→バックアップ：04870_bakkuappu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: This system is backed up on a daily basis.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (day) + {次|じ} (order, sequence) = day-by-day order, daily

SIMILAR TIME-FREQUENCY TERMS:
- {日次|にちじ}: daily
- {週次|しゅうじ}: weekly
- {月次|げつじ}: monthly
- ⟦{年次|ねんじ}→年次：15657_nenji⟧: annual

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日次|にちじ}⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧: daily report
- {日次|にちじ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: daily processing
- {日次|にちじ}{集計|しゅうけい}: daily aggregation
- {日次|にちじ}バッチ: daily batch (IT)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧ (date and time), which has the same reading but different meaning and kanji. {日次|にちじ} is primarily a business and technical term.
